method: Batch size4. Group identical class-token positions, clone and repeat the same common-prefix cache across the batch, preserve offsets and causal layout, use unchanged full-vocabulary label validity and six conditional fields.
qualification: Complete existing400-case screen, same selected checkpoint/input bytes, zero decisions/field-label/validity differences and abstentions, maximum conditional-probability difference<=0.001. Batch/full logits also checked for two screen rows.
adoption: Use batching only if parity passes and observed screen decoding time is lower than its cached single-message reference. Otherwise retain original evaluator. Comparison bounded to360seconds.
timing_limit: Cached reference timing is not a controlled hardware benchmark.
